description: A roving focus list in the style of bits-ui's RovingFocusGroup and Tabs (fixture roving-svelte, also run by the differential: no layout reads): options typed as a union of object types (one record), svelte-toolbelt's box(), a SvelteMap of labels read by derived values (registered and deleted by the items), querySelectorAll over the list ([attr]:not([data-disabled])), a dictionary object from keys to indices ({ [next]: …, Home: 0, … }, read with e.key and written with a computed key), a record read with a computed key ({ horizontal, vertical }[orientation]), Object.is, $state.snapshot, and a method bound after the constructor's first statements. Moved with the arrow keys in both orientations, Home, End, Enter and Escape, with and without looping, while an item is disabled and while one is removed
